decision.reason: Every original, displaced and fixed-density replay passes independent energy 1e-8 Eh and force 1e-7 Eh/Bohr gates. Timings are observations of explicitly selected policies at these sizes, not general/default performance promotion.

reproduction.instructions: Build the pinned composition with verified ccache, Release/sm_120, and exact offline basis. Run each engine through finite Slurm main --gres=gpu:5090:1, 8 CPUs/16 GiB; preserve device visibility, select the verified library, set three BLAS thread counts to 8, GENERATIVEQC_CUDA_KS_ACTIVE_AO=1 and GENERATIVEQC_BOUNDED_SCHWARZ_SCHEDULE=indexed. First run the reference mode without native-only switches; then run native none and lda16 in separate processes with the same reference bytes. All detailed protocols, original reports, identities and outcomes are retained. Imports/library probes are outside prepared cold; this is not an empty disk/JIT-cache measurement.
